input.quote: THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5 gives only knowledge-qualified legal-compliance, authority and non-infringement representations — there is no warranty that the Works conform to the Specifications or documentation, no warranty period and no remedy, while all implied warranties are disclaimed. That is short of the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with repair, replace or refund). Redline inserts a 90-day conformance warranty plus workmanlike-services warranty and remedy, carved out of the disclaimer.

input.quote: Contractor shall maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) and professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000)
input.rationale: Workers' compensation, CGL USD 1M, E&O USD 1M and certificates on request are in place, but there is no cyber/privacy cover at all even though Contractor handles Company records and Confidential Information, so the clause misses the fallback (E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M). Redline adds cyber liability at USD 2M only; we have not pressed the higher preferred CGL aggregate or E&O limits.
